summary: AMC Robotics filed an 8-K on September 17, 2026, disclosing a Standby Equity Purchase Agreement with Ayame Asset Holdings LLC giving the company the right, but not the obligation, to sell up to $50.0 million of newly issued common stock over the agreement term. Individual advances are capped at the lower of 100% of five-day average daily trading volume or 100,000 shares, at 96% of the three-day lowest VWAP or 97% of the five-day lowest VWAP. Advances are conditioned on an effective resale registration statement and are blocked while a Promissory Note remains outstanding. This is a dilutive equity line facility, functioning like a US-listed at-the-market or standby equity distribution agreement; investors should watch resale registration effectiveness, SEPA pricing floors, and any existing note overhang that could delay drawdowns.
